title: API proposal: numeric selector

comments.body: Why is it limited to numeric values? The use case looks like it could use any kind of refinement (strings).

> Why is it limited to numeric values? The use case looks like it could use any kind of refinement (strings).

We could probably build a `facetSelector` as well but not sure we want to mix it in a single widget: I think it's easier to understand not mixing the `operator` VS `disjunctive` VS .... Also the underlying code would be pretty different because of that `operator`. WDYT?

Yes, makes sense. It would be much easier to have two widgets, otherwise the underlyong code will get too messy.

I'll add comments on the PR
